summary.text: Andrew Gerena is an independent candidate for U.S. Senate who describes himself as a working-class American with experience in military service, security, commercial trucking, information technology, food service and scientific research.

paragraphs.text: Says he has life and employment experience ranging from military service to security, commercial trucking, information technology, food service and scientific research.
Earned an associate degree from Bryant & Stratton College in 2014; Ballotpedia lists his career experience as a technician.
Describes himself as a hiker, runner, motorcyclist and do-it-yourselfer, and says he is running with no political connections or financial support.
